name: Swadesh Restaurant (Woods at Sasan)
signature_dish: Kathiyawadi Gujarati thali in copper plate with 10 bowls
why_it_matters: Tripadvisor's #2-ranked Sasan Gir restaurant (4.8/5, ~26 reviews) — the regional cuisine speciality at Woods at Sasan, a 5-star resort in a mango orchard. Thali is served in a square copper plate with a set of 10 bowls; ingredients are seasonal and largely sourced from the resort's own farm. Weekend dinners include live folk music.
insider_tip: Best as a single destination meal (the resort is 6 km from safari gate). Book the weekend slot for live music — Friday and Saturday dinner are the cultural-set evenings. Open to non-resident guests with prior call.
signature_address: Woods at Sasan, near Sangodra Railway Crossing, Sasan-Talala Road, Village Bhojde, Sasan Gir 362150

name: Terracotta: Cuisines from the Globe (Woods at Sasan)
signature_dish: All-day international cuisine in a jungle-lodge setting
why_it_matters: Tripadvisor's #1-ranked Sasan Gir restaurant (4.6/5, ~31 reviews) — Woods at Sasan's all-day diner serving Indian + international classics, plus a round-the-clock à la carte for safari-tired guests on offbeat schedules. The complement to its Swadesh sibling for those who want pasta or pizza after a Kathiyawadi-heavy week.
insider_tip: If staying at Woods, both Swadesh + Terracotta are bundled in the F&B plan — alternate them. Open to non-residents but call ahead; 6 km from the safari gate so plan transport.
signature_address: Woods at Sasan, near Sangodra Railway Crossing, Sasan-Talala Road, Village Bhojde, Sasan Gir 362150

name: Flavours of Forest Restaurant (Asiatic Lion Lodge)
why_it_matters: Tripadvisor #3 of 13 Sasan Gir restaurants (4.6/5, ~16 reviews) — the in-house restaurant at Asiatic Lion Lodge with a documented sustainability claim of 70% on-farm vegetable sourcing. Useful for travellers wanting the Kathiyawadi side without the Woods-level price ceiling.
insider_tip: Resort guests get first dibs at meal times; outside guests should call ahead and time it for the 1.30 PM lunch slot after the morning safari. Asks for 'today's farm shaak' is the right question — the menu rotates with the harvest.
signature_address: Asiatic Lion Lodge, Sasan Gir, Gir Somnath District 362135

name: Gir Kathiyawadi Restaurant
why_it_matters: Tripadvisor #4-ranked Sasan Gir restaurant — a standalone, non-resort Kathiyawadi address on the Sasan-Talala highway. Unlimited thali at ₹125/head includes wheat roti + bajra roti + rice + dal + undeo + two veg + soft local jaggery, ghee, and buttermilk. Google reviewers give 4.4/5 across ~178 reviews; the budget pick over the ₹1000+ resort thalis.
insider_tip: Order the local 'soft jaggery + ghee + bajra rotla' combo — it's the proper Kathiyawadi closer most travellers miss because they're full by then. Lunch (12-2 PM) is hottest off the tava.
signature_address: Sasan-Talala Highway, Sasan Gir, Gir Somnath District 362135

name: Machan (Club Mahindra Gir)
why_it_matters: Club Mahindra Gir's flagship all-day diner — featured on Club Mahindra's national restaurant index as a Kathiyawadi specialist serving lasaniya batata, sev tameta nu shaak, and handvo as named signature plates. The Barbeque Bay companion outlet offers kebab + grill for al fresco evenings.
insider_tip: Restaurant prioritises resort guests; non-residents should call 24 hours ahead. Pair with Barbeque Bay for dinner — alternate between Kathiyawadi lunch + grill dinner over a 2-night stay.
signature_address: Club Mahindra Gir Resort, Sasan Gir, Gir Somnath District 362135
